products.name: Shineboard Arts: For Tamepass
products.short_html: 'Please do not urien hear and thear', is a desperate plea repeated in many different styles. But all pleading with the rather loose bladdered Indian male. And the lack of public toilets. Sometimes the messages are more threatening. 'Newshance Makars will be vacated this place' has a Victorian air of authority about it, even if the spelling is not quite the Queens' own. Sometimes there is an appeal to the Newshance Makars sense of shame. ' Please not urien pass this place man. Only Dog'!! But the urge to urien pass might be hard to control after too much 'Child Bear with 'Masala Pee Nuts'. Likewise there are other common categories. Ladies garments. Meat shops. Bars and eateries. Mechanics, punchers (oops punctures). Death coffins and horses. And the three South Indian obsessions. Sex, Love and Cinema. 101% Lethal. Export Quality. English. Colour. Enjoy. Exempt of GST

products.name: On a High Note
products.short_html: The elements of music the world over are very much the same... melody, rhythym, voices, instruments, harmony and emotions. One thing sets Western Classical Music apart... It is the only musical culture where the composer has a more important role than the performer or conductor. His composition, his delineation of sound and melody, remain precise, immutable and alive... centuries after he himself is dead (and decomposed!) For anyone who never studied theory (or who dropped out of Miss Fingerwhacker's class after two lessons), lets start with the basics. Exempt of GST
